subject: Request: same-day late arrival — propose compressed interview / take-home
messages:
From: Samantha Park <samantha.park+recruiting@gmail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Today — interview at 2pm (can be late)

Hi Olga + Marissa,

I am really sorry to do this last-minute — our nanny didn’t show up unexpectedly this morning and I’m scrambling to find coverage. There’s a chance I can still make the 2:00pm panel but I may be ~60 minutes late. I know this is inconvenient.

If it helps the team, I’d be happy to:
- shift to a single 20–30 minute phone/Zoom with the hiring manager today and do the coding exercise as a take-home to submit by EOD, or
- move the full panel to later today if any slots are free, or
- reschedule to the earliest available day this week.

I attached an updated resume in case that’s helpful. Please let me know what option works best for the team.

Thanks so much for understanding — really want to make this workable.

Best,
Samantha Park
(415) 555-0192
Attachments: updated_resume.pdf (PDF, 118 KB)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Today — interview at 2pm (can be late)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads up and no worries, we can make this work. Appreciate you flagging it early.

Quick preferences from our side so we keep the interview experience consistent:
- Option A (same-day, compressed): 20 min conversation with the hiring manager (Markus) + a 30 min independent take-home coding task to be submitted by EOD tomorrow. We’ll also record a short design prompt you can record a 3–5 minute walkthrough for (optional).
- Option B (reschedule): move your full panel to the next available slot (we have openings Wednesday afternoon and Thursday morning).

If Option A works, we’ll:
1) schedule a 20-minute Zoom at 3:30pm today with Markus.
2) send micro-interview instructions (attached) and the take-home task link immediately after the call.

Markus — do you have capacity for a 3:30pm 20-min screen + a short same-day debrief (20 min) if Samantha opts for Option A?

Samantha — if you’d rather reschedule, we’ll prioritize an early slot this week.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
Attachments: micro-interview-instructions.pdf (PDF, 24 KB)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Today — interview at 2pm (can be late)

Thanks for flagging, Olga. I can do the compressed flow today. A couple of notes:
- Let’s trim the live conversation to 15 minutes focusing on role fit + troubleshooting mindset; I’ll leave deep technical eval to the take-home.
- If Samantha agrees, I’m fine with a 20-minute debrief immediately after (we can do that as a quick 1:1).
- Please send the calendar invites (15m screen @ 3:30pm; 20m debrief @ 4:00pm) and include a link to the take-home (I’ll review submissions tomorrow morning).

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-olga-20260515

Olga/Marissa — let me know if you want a one-paragraph rubric I can paste into the take-home instructions.

-Markus
From: Samantha Park <samantha.park+recruiting@gmail.com>

Hi — thanks, Olga and Markus. Option A (compressed) works for me. I can be on Zoom by 3:30pm — should be settled by then. I’m happy to do the take-home and submit by EOD tomorrow; I’ll also record a short design walkthrough if helpful.

Please send the Zoom links and the task. Really appreciate the flexibility.

See you at 3:30,
Samantha
